jobs.employer_name: ISR International School on the Rhine GmbH
jobs.description:
Job Overview

ISR is accredited by the German authorities as an ‘Anerkannte Internationale Ergänzungsschule’ (International Supplementary School) and by the US accrediting agency Cognia (formerly known as AdvancED). ISR is an IB World School authorized to offer the IB Diploma Programme, and also offers Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE) IGCSE courses. The school is a certified member of the Council of International Schools (CIS).

We wish to hire a dedicated and qualified full-time Admissions Employee (m/f/d) to join our dynamic educational institution from Autumn, 2026.

The successful candidate should be outgoing, confident in communicating with a wide range of people and able to build positive relationships quickly. Strong interpersonal skills, a collaborative mindset and a flexible approach to work are essential. A general understanding of different school systems and educational pathways would be an advantage.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

- Proactively contact interested families, provide relevant information and identify their individual needs.
- Manage and respond to all incoming enquiries from prospective families in a timely and professional manner.
- Maintain accurate records in the admissions database and ensure consistent follow-up throughout the enquiry process.
- Conduct school tours during regular school operations and provide personalised guidance on ISR’s educational programs and school community.
- Support prospective families throughout the entire application and enrolment process.
- Represent ISR and present its educational concept at internal and external events.
- Attend and actively support the planning, coordination, and delivery of information sessions, open days, and Saturday Info Days.
- Build positive and trusting relationships with prospective families while ensuring a welcoming and professional experience at every stage

Qualifications

- Completed vocational training or a university degree.
- Previous experience in customer service, client advisory or sales.
- Excellent written and spoken English and German; additional language skills would be an advantage.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- A professional, service-oriented and approachable manner.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Flexibility, reliability and strong organisational skills.
- Strong IT skills, particularly in Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience with Veracross is an advantage

Job Benefits

We are looking for someone who can make an immediate impact in a fast-paced, dynamic, and rewarding working environment. In return, we offer a range of opportunities for professional growth and career development.

If you are enthusiastic, highly motivated, enjoy a challenge, and believe you can contribute to the continued growth and development of our new ISR Elementary School Düsseldorf, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Contacts

Monthly salary from €6,035+, depending on experience.

What Will Put You Ahead (Preferred Skills):

- Excellent earning opportunities according to the Caterpillar compensation system

We are back! This role requires being in the office five days a week.

• Strong knowledge in embedded programming, systematic debugging methodology and -tools and software development processes

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Chemical Quality & Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) Are you
ready to design, build, and run a state-of-the-art analytical
chemistry laboratory from the ground up? As a Chemical Quality &
Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you will be key to establishing
our chemical laboratory infrastructure in Dresden. Starting on January 2027, you will manage our analytical instruments, set up
testing standards, and verify the quality of incoming materials and
facility chemical systems. Collaborating closely with our advanced
teams in Taiwan and leading a small group of local technicians, you
will directly safeguard the production quality of Europe's newest
premier semiconductor fab! Tasks Lab Infrastructure Setup: Design,
establish, and optimize our on-site chemical lab capacity, process
setups, and analytical capabilities. Instrument Management: Lead the
operation, calibration, and maintenance of high-precision analytical
equipment, with a focus on ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, and Ion
Chromatography (IC). Material Quality Control: Execute routine and
event-triggered monitoring of incoming chemicals and raw materials to
ensure strict compliance with manufacturing standards. Technical
Writing: Define Operational Instructions (OIs) and Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs) for the laboratory environment. Team Leadership:
Supervise, train, and coordinate a small, dedicated group of
laboratory technicians. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with
fab and facility teams to troubleshoot chemical events, support
continuous improvement projects (CIP), and verify tool certifications.
Emergency On-Duty Support: Participate in weekend and night-shift
on-duty rotations to handle urgent chemical safety or quality
escalations. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s
degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Material Science, or a
related scientific discipline. Technical Experience: 0 to 3 years of
hands-on experience in chemical analysis, with deep knowledge of
analytical techniques such as ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, or Ion
Chromatography (IC). Analytical Skillset: Experience in standard
sample preparation, calibration curves, statistical process control
(SPC) data interpretation, and analytical instrument troubleshooting.
Soft Skills: Strong collaborative mindset, intercultural openness,
resilience under pressure, and a structured, detail-oriented approach
to safety and quality. Languages: Fluency in English (written and
spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Prior experience in a semiconductor
manufacturing environment or cleanroom chemical lab management.
Knowledge of European chemical regulations (such as REACH) and safety
standards. Basic programming skills (e.g., Python, R, or SQL) for
analytical data processing. Basic communication skills in German
and/or Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent
employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of
Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from
TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan
(ESPP). Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center,
gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating
complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training,
while you continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An
annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports
classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals &
Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized
public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional
contact details Please apply with your english resume.

international teams and senior management. Languages: Fluent in

stability? As an SPC & Metrology Quality Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you

and tool matching of inline metrology systems (such as OCD, CDSEM, and

Collaboration: Partner with engineering teams at our Taiwan

The arbovirus research group of PD Dr. Beate Kümmerer at the Institute of Virology at the University Hospital Bonn (Germany) is looking for a highly motivated

PhD student (m/f/d)

to join our team and explore the fascinating biology of orthoflavivirus-host interaction in mosquitoes and vertebrates. The PhD position (65% E13 salary according to DFG recommendations), initially limited to three years, is advertisedwithin the framework of the DFG-funded CRC/Transregio 237 “Nucleic Acid Immunity” and is to be filled by January 2027.

The position is offered on a fixed-term basis until December 31, 2029.
Mosquito-borne RNA viruses, such as dengue, yellow fever, and Zika virus, cause severe disease outbreaks worldwide. As climate change drives the spread of mosquito vectors, the regions affected by these viruses continue to expand. Orthoflaviviruses have evolved multiple strategies to evade innate immune recognition, thereby promoting viral replication and pathogenesis. The project aims to elucidate how viral RNA structures and RNA modifications shape innate immune recognition. A particular focus will be the identification of mosquito proteins that recognize viral cap0 RNA and the characterization of viral immune antagonists in both mosquito and vertebrate hosts. We hope to gain mechanistic insights into virus-host interactions that support the development of innovative antiviral therapies and sustainable vector control strategies.

Methods: Molecular biology methods, cell culture and virological methods, RNA-protein and protein-protein interaction studies, gene expression analyses, cellular knock-down, as well as research involving mosquitoes.

Master’s degree in life sciences
Enthusiasm for research in a collaborative environment
Commitment to the research project

A Snapshot of Your Day 

A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our global and diverse Gas Services (GS) organization, where putting the customer at the heart of every decision and continuously improving how we operate are the foundation of quality. Quality is more than reporting, firefighting, and correcting issues after the fact — it is about turning experience into sustainable learning and lasting improvement.
As Service Quality Professional you will act as a trusted partner and point of contact for our Regional Service Unit (RSU), driving important Service Quality initiatives and process improvements across GS. You will connect the Regional Service Units, Global Service Operations, and other stakeholders on key quality topics — sharing best practices, driving common standards, and creating transparency. Balancing global, strategic initiatives with selective, hands-on regional support, you will help ensure quality programs are successfully implemented and that sustainable improvements — measured by non-conformance costs (NCC) and customer satisfaction (NPS) — are achieved.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Act as a reliable, competent point of contact for RSU on quality topics, hurdles, and questions, ensuring RSU interests are considered in EQS decision-making.
* Enable the RSU QM community by providing the support needed to successfully implement quality programs and achieve measurable, sustainable improvements in Service Quality.
* Drive global focus-area initiatives — Customer Excellence / NPS, Service CAPA, and Process Management — in alignment with RSU needs, EQS stakeholders, and process owners.
* Support and govern prioritized improvement projects across regions, and global functions, ensuring visible, customer-felt impact.
* Foster process implementation, harmonization, and comparability of results across RSUs to reduce complexity and boost efficiency.
* Act proactively based on data — leverage dashboards, KPIs, and AI-supported insights to identify focus areas and accelerate decisions.
* Identify global, systemic issues and initiate targeted, cross-regional improvement actions, applying structured problem-solving and continuous-improvement methods.
* Facilitate best-practice sharing by highlighting regional successes and systematically addressing areas for improvement across the GS Service network.
* Provide transparency through structured reporting, and maintenance of relevant frameworks (e.g., Hoshin Kanri, Quality DoR)

What You Bring

* University degree in engineering, business, quality management, or a comparable field.
* Solid experience in quality management, process management, service operations, or continuous improvement, ideally within a complex, international, service-oriented organization.
* Understanding of quality methods and standards (e.g., ISO 9001), including non-conformance management, and their integration into daily processes.
* Experience applying continuous improvement and problem-solving methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, root-cause analysis) across multiple organizations.
* Affinity for digitalization and AI to make quality and process knowledge more accessible and processes smarter (e.g., SEPH, BIC Cloud, and related tools).
* Excellent stakeholder management, great communicator, and organizational skills, with the ability to build trust across cultures, regions, and hierarchy levels.
* Proactive, self-driven, and customer-centric mindset, balancing global strategic goals with pragmatic regional support.
* Fluency in English; further languages are a plus given the global scope of the role.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

materials-, and tool handling. Monitors operation of the mechanical /
electrical operating equipment. Observes gauges, signals and recording
instruments turns valves, moves controls to regulate temperatures,
pressures, flow of heating water, coolant to effectively monitor
critical limits. Performs standard diagnostics, monitor site

operation within specifications in conformity with plant standards.

jobs.occupation: International Logistics Specialist (Import/Export) (m/f/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Groß- und Außenhandel (Außenhandel))
jobs.description:
About us Die European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik
im Herzen Europas, die kleinste Fertigungstechnologien für
Halbleiterprodukte der nächsten Generation bietet. ESMC steht für
das gemeinsame Engagement zur Stärkung des europäischen
Halbleiter-Ökosystems. Für unsere zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen
wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: International Logistics
Specialist (Import/Export) (m/f/d) At ESMC, we are building a
state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in Dresden. As part of our
international Supply Chain organization, you will play a key role in
establishing efficient global logistics processes that ensure the
reliable movement of materials, equipment and goods across
international borders. This position offers the opportunity to shape
logistics processes from the ground up in an international greenfield
environment while working closely with colleagues, logistics providers
and customs authorities around the world. Tasks Manage international
import and export shipments for the Dresden fab and related locations.
Coordinate daily logistics operations together with freight forwarders
and logistics service providers. Support customs clearance activities
and ensure compliant import and export processes. Review
logistics-related invoices and payment processes within SAP. Monitor
logistics service providers against agreed KPIs and support continuous
performance improvements. Collaborate closely with internal
departments, suppliers, customs authorities and international
logistics partners. Support the implementation and harmonization of
global logistics processes and systems. Identify opportunities to
improve logistics, customs and global trade processes in a rapidly
growing manufacturing environment. Contribute to establishing scalable
logistics structures within our greenfield project. Profile Required:
Bachelor’s or Master´s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain
Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a
comparable qualification. Several years of professional experience
(approximately 7+ years) in international logistics, import/export,
customs or global trade. Strong knowledge of customs regulations and
international import/export processes. Practical experience
coordinating international shipments. Experience working with customs
brokers, freight forwarders and logistics providers. Strong
communication skills and experience working with international
stakeholders. Fluent German and good English skills. Nice to have:
Experience within semiconductor, electronics, automotive or other
manufacturing industries. Experience with SAP, ideally SAP S/4HANA.
Knowledge of export control regulations. Mandarin language skills. We
offer Help build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in
Europe. Work in a highly international environment with colleagues
across Europe, Taiwan and the US. Shape logistics processes instead of
maintaining existing structures. Participate in global projects and
cross-functional collaboration. International onboarding including
4–6 weeks of training in Taiwan and Arizona. Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume. The ESMC recruiting
team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits the hiring
criteria.
